name: Cartflox
description: Cartflox is a payment orchestration API for Africa: it routes Mobile Money and card payments through your own aggregator accounts (PayDunya, PawaPay, CinetPay, Flutterwave, Paystack, Hub2...), with a hosted payment page, payment links, Mobile Money transfers, signed webhooks and a test mode driven by af_test_ keys.
example_prompt: Use Cartflox to create a 5,000 XOF checkout session for order 1042, redirect the customer to the hosted payment page, and mark the order paid only on the verified payment.completed webhook.
